name: Business Strategy & Analysis
new_description: Explore the dynamic principles that drive successful business strategy and organizational decision-making. Delve into economic theories, market analysis, and management concepts to understand how companies navigate competitive landscapes, allocate resources, and achieve sustainable growth. Investigate the mechanisms behind strategic planning, competitive positioning, and performance evaluation to gain insights into the strategic choices that shape the business world.
focus_areas: economic theory, market dynamics, organizational behavior, strategic planning, performance analysis

name: Physics
new_description: Dive into the fascinating world of physics! Explore the laws that govern the motion of objects, from speeding cars to soaring basketballs. Discover how energy can transform from one form to another, like heat turning into electricity. Investigate the mysterious nature of waves, from the vibrations that create sound to the invisible light that allows us to see. Get ready to uncover the hidden forces that shape our universe, from the tiniest atoms to the grandest galaxies.
focus_areas: motion, energy, waves, electromagnetism, quantum phenomena

name: Cyrillic Alphabet
new_description: Explore the unique Cyrillic alphabet, the writing system used for the Russian language. Discover the fascinating shapes and sounds of these Slavic letters, from the familiar 'A' and 'B' to the intriguing 'Ж' and 'Ц'. Learn how to read and write the Cyrillic alphabet, mastering the patterns and rules that set it apart from the Latin alphabet you're used to. Dive into the cultural context behind this ancient script and how it has evolved over centuries. With engaging lessons and interactive exercises, you'll develop a solid foundation in this captivating language.
focus_areas: Cyrillic letter shapes and sounds, Reading and writing the Cyrillic alphabet, Cultural context and history of the Cyrillic script
